raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Fixes #44941.

Cross-pollinates `BaseFormatDetector` / vLLM unknown-tool validation and exact partial-token suffix matching into `DeepSeekV32Detector` (shared by `DeepSeekV3.2`, `DeepSeekV4`, and `DeepSeekV4.1`):

1. **Streaming vs. Non-Streaming Disagreement on Unknown Tool Calls**:
   - `DeepSeekV32Detector.detect_and_parse()` delegates to `self.parse_base_json()`, which drops tool calls whose function name is not in `self._get_tool_indices(tools)` unless `SGLANG_FORWARD_UNKNOWN_TOOLS` is set.
   - `DeepSeekV32Detector.parse_streaming_increment()` bypassed `parse_base_json()` and constructed `ToolCallItem` directly without checking `_get_tool_indices(tools)` or `SGLANG_FORWARD_UNKNOWN_TOOLS`, causing streaming responses to emit undefined tool calls that one-shot responses reject.

2. **Non-DSML Fullwidth-Bar Tags (`<｜end｜>`) Stall Streaming Indefinitely**:
   - `parse_streaming_increment()` buffered whenever `current_text` contained `f"<{bar}"` (`<｜`), which matches any fullwidth-bar special token in prose (e.g., `<｜end｜>`), holding all subsequent normal text in `self._buffer` until `finish()`.

3. **Bare `｜DSML｜` Mention in Prose Truncates Text at Stream End**:
   - Both `potentially_dsml` and `_text_before_dsml()` matched bare `self.dsml_token` (`｜DSML｜`) even without a leading `<` or `</`. When a response mentioned `｜DSML｜` in plain prose (e.g., `"The tag ｜DSML｜ marks tool calls."`), streaming stalled and `finish()` truncated everything from `｜DSML｜` onward.

## Modifications

- **`python/sglang/srt/function_call/deepseekv32_detector.py`**:
  - Check `func_name in tool_indices` in `parse_streaming_increment()` after initial preamble/state setup and skip unknown tools (logging a warning) unless `envs.SGLANG_FORWARD_UNKNOWN_TOOLS.get()` is enabled, preserving `tool_index` numbering for subsequent valid calls and withholding trailing `</｜DSML｜...>` tags on `finish()`.
  - Replace the overly broad `<｜` and bare `｜DSML｜` substring checks with `_has_dsml_tag()` and `_has_partial_dsml_tag_suffix()` (using `BaseFormatDetector._ends_with_partial_token()`), and anchor `_text_before_dsml()` on actual DSML tool-call tags (`bot_token` / `invoke_start_token`) or their trailing partial prefixes.
- **`test/registered/unit/function_call/test_deepseekv4_detector.py`**:
  - Added unit tests covering streaming vs. non-streaming unknown-tool filtering (both default and with `SGLANG_FORWARD_UNKNOWN_TOOLS=True`), unknown-only invoke `finish()` cleanup, `<｜end｜>` streaming without stalling, and literal `｜DSML｜` in plain prose across chunk widths.

### Credits & Acknowledgments
- Full credit to **@divyvasal** for discovering, isolating, and documenting all of these DeepSeek V3.2/V4/V4.1 streaming tool-call parser discrepancies in #44941 while differentially fuzzing `DeepSeekV32Detector` (#44940), and for reviewing this PR with differential fuzzing to catch two additional edge cases (`00abb4ef`).

nodes.body: Gentle, polite ping @hnyls2002 @JustinTong0323 @ch-wan @ispobock (and cc issue author @divyvasal) — whenever you have a spare moment, would you mind taking a look at this self-contained fix for the DeepSeek V3.2/V4/V4.1 DSML streaming detector edge cases in #44941? It aligns streaming unknown-tool filtering, invoke prefix matching, and parameter-value close-tag holdback with `detect_and_parse`, verified by 18 unit tests in `test_deepseekv4_detector.py`. Thank you very much for your time!

Thanks for picking this up, @deep1blue. As the issue author I checked it against the repros and a differential fuzzer (streaming over many chunkings vs `detect_and_parse`, V3.2/V4/V4.1). Items 1–3 are fixed: unknown tools are dropped the same way in both paths (indices stay contiguous, `SGLANG_FORWARD_UNKNOWN_TOOLS` still forwards), and the `<｜…` / bare `｜DSML｜` cases stream promptly and agree with `detect_and_parse`. Valid DSML split at every character boundary behaves exactly as on main.

One regression: the new partial-suffix fallback in `_text_before_dsml` (L134-138) is only reached from `finish()`, where a partial tag can no longer complete, so a reply ending on `<`, `<｜` … `<｜DSML` now loses that tail (and a preceding `\n\n`):
```
stream ["for (int i = 0; i ", "<"] -> "for (int i = 0; i "
parse_non_stream                   -> "for (int i = 0; i <"
```
Main keeps it. Deleting that fallback, so it cuts only at a full `bot_token` / `invoke_start_token`, fixes it (the streaming hold already uses `_has_partial_dsml_tag_suffix`); with that change all 40k fuzz cases agree with `parse_non_stream` and your tests still pass. A test like streaming `["for (i ", "<"]` then expecting `"for (i <"` would pin it.

Smaller, out-of-spec input only: after an invoke, stray fragments that aren't one of the four full tags (e.g. `</｜DSML｜parameter>` between invokes, or a V3.2 `</｜DSML｜function_calls>` under the V4 parser) now stream as content where main held them; and the bare-invoke path of `detect_and_parse` now keeps a foreign wrapper like `<｜DSML｜function_calls>` in `normal_text`.

On tests: reverting the `_text_before_dsml` anchoring, or re-adding bare `｜DSML｜` to `_has_dsml_tag`, still passes the suite, and the unknown-tool tests cover V4 with one chunk. Your comment mentions 18 tests and a parameter-value close-tag holdback; the pushed head has 4 new tests and doesn't touch parameter parsing. Is there a commit still to push?

This conflicts with my #44940 in one hunk of `parse_streaming_increment`. I checked the combination and there's no behavioural interaction, so I'm happy to rebase #44940 onto this once it lands.

Thanks for the thorough review and differential fuzzing, @divyvasal! Fixed in `00abb4ef`:

1. **`_text_before_dsml` partial-suffix truncation at EOF**: Removed the `_ends_with_partial_token` fallback from `_text_before_dsml` so it only slices at a full `self.bot_token` or `self.invoke_start_token`. Replies ending with `<`, `<｜`, `<｜DSML`, `</`, etc. at stream end now flush unchanged in `finish()` (preserving any preceding `\n\n`) and match `detect_and_parse`.
2. **Post-invoke stray DSML fragments**: Added `self.current_tool_id != -1 and (f"<{self.dsml_token}" in text or f"</{self.dsml_token}" in text)` in `_has_dsml_tag` so stray DSML fragments after a completed invoke (e.g., `</｜DSML｜parameter>` between invokes or a V3.2 `</｜DSML｜function_calls>` under V4/V4.1) stay held in `_buffer` instead of streaming as `normal_text`, matching `main` and `detect_and_parse`.
3. **Tests & mutation coverage**:
   - Added `test_trailing_partial_dsml_prefix_preserved_at_stream_end` and `test_stray_dsml_fragment_after_invoke_does_not_leak` across `DeepSeekV32Detector`, `DeepSeekV4Detector`, and `DeepSeekV41Detector`.
   - Hardened `test_literal_dsml_token_in_plain_prose_streams_without_truncation` to assert immediate emission on `parse_streaming_increment` before `finish()` (fails if bare `self.dsml_token` is re-added to `_has_dsml_tag`) and to exercise `_text_before_dsml` on buffered prose containing bare `｜DSML｜` both when held until `finish()` and before a bare invoke (fails if `_text_before_dsml` anchoring is reverted).
   - Parameterized the unknown-tool streaming tests across `DeepSeekV32Detector`, `DeepSeekV4Detector`, and `DeepSeekV41Detector` and chunk widths (`1, 5, 13, len(text)`).
4. **On the earlier comment**: Confirming nothing was left unpushed—that note misstated the test count and conflated parameter-value close-tag holdback from a separate vLLM DSML parser PR (`vllm#62259`); in SGLang, `#39632` already waits for a complete `</｜DSML｜invoke>` before parsing parameters.

**Verification:** Ran all 31 unit tests in `test/registered/unit/function_call/test_deepseekv4_detector.py` locally, verified that reverting each of the four conditions above fails the suite, and ran a 40,000-trial differential fuzzer across `DeepSeekV32Detector`, `DeepSeekV4Detector`, and `DeepSeekV41Detector` comparing `parse_streaming_increment` + `finish()` against `detect_and_parse` (0 mismatches).

         """Check if the text contains a deepseek v32 format tool call."""
         return self.bot_token in text or self.invoke_start_token in text
 
+    def _has_dsml_tag(self, text: str) -> bool:
+        if self.current_tool_id != -1 and (
+            f"<{self.dsml_token}" in text or f"</{self.dsml_token}" in text
+        ):
+            return True
+        return (
+            self.has_tool_call(text)
+            or self.eot_token in text
+            or self.invoke_end_token in text
+        )
+
+    def _has_partial_dsml_tag_suffix(self, text: str) -> bool:
+        return any(
+            self._ends_with_partial_token(text, token) > 0
+            for token in (
+                self.bot_token,
+                self.eot_token,
+                self.invoke_start_token,
+                self.invoke_end_token,
+            )
+        )
+
     def _text_before_dsml(self, text: str) -> str:
-        """Prose preceding the first DSML tag, with the trailing blank line the
-        chat template inserts before a tool call removed."""
-        idx = text.find(self.dsml_token)
-        if idx == -1:
+        """Prose preceding the first DSML tool-call tag, with the trailing blank
+        line the chat template inserts before a tool call removed."""
+        positions = [
+            pos
+            for pos in (text.find(self.bot_token), text.find(self.invoke_start_token))
+            if pos != -1
+        ]
+        if not positions:
             return text

-            idx -= 2
-        elif idx >= 1 and text[idx - 1] == "<":
-            idx -= 1

@@ -4,7 +4,9 @@
 from unittest.mock import patch
 
 from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.protocol import Function, Tool
+from sglang.srt.function_call.deepseekv32_detector import DeepSeekV32Detector
 from sglang.srt.function_call.deepseekv4_detector import DeepSeekV4Detector
+from sglang.srt.function_call.deepseekv41_detector import DeepSeekV41Detector
 from sglang.srt.function_call.function_call_parser import FunctionCallParser
 from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
 
@@ -417,6 +419,231 @@ def test_unexpected_parse_error_fails_closed(self):
         self.assertEqual(first.calls, [])
         self.assertEqual(second.normal_text, " tail")
 
+    def _feed_all(self, chunks, detector_cls=DeepSeekV4Detector):
+        """Returns (normal_text, calls) accumulated over chunks plus finish()."""
+        detector = detector_cls()
+        normal, calls = "", []
+        for chunk in chunks:
+            result = detector.parse_streaming_increment(chunk, self.tools)
+            normal += result.normal_text
+            calls.extend(result.calls)
+        end = detector.finish(self.tools)
+        normal += end.normal_text
+        calls.extend(end.calls)
+        return normal, calls
+
+    def test_streaming_drops_unknown_tool_unless_forward_unknown_enabled(self):
+        """Streaming and non-streaming must agree on unknown tool calls across
+        V3.2, V4, and V4.1 detectors and chunk sizes."""
+        for cls in (DeepSeekV32Detector, DeepSeekV4Detector, DeepSeekV41Detector):
+            d = cls()
+            p = f"{d.dsml_token}{cls.parameter_tag_name}"
+            text = (
+                f"Checking.\n\n{d.bot_token}\n"
+                f'{d.invoke_start_token} name="unknown_tool">\n'
+                f'<{p} name="city" string="true">SF</{p}>\n'
+                f"{d.invoke_end_token}\n"
+                f'{d.invoke_start_token} name="get_weather">\n'
+                f'<{p} name="city" string="true">NY</{p}>\n'
+                f"{d.invoke_end_token}\n"
+                f"{d.eot_token}"
+            )
+            one_shot = cls().detect_and_parse(text, self.tools)
+            self.assertEqual(one_shot.normal_text, "Checking.")
+            self.assertEqual(
+                [(call.name, call.parameters) for call in one_shot.calls],
+                [("get_weather", '{"city": "NY"}')],
+            )
+            for width in (1, 5, 13, len(text)):
+                chunks = [text[i : i + width] for i in range(0, len(text), width)]
+                with self.subTest(cls=cls.__name__, width=width):
+                    normal, calls = self._feed_all(chunks, cls)
+                    self.assertEqual(normal, one_shot.normal_text)
+                    self.assertEqual(
+                        [(call.tool_index, call.name, call.parameters) for call in calls],
+                        [(0, "get_weather", '{"city": "NY"}')],
+                    )
+
+            with patch(
+                "sglang.srt.function_call.deepseekv32_detector.envs.SGLANG_FORWARD_UNKNOWN_TOOLS.get",
+                return_value=True,
+            ), patch(
+                "sglang.srt.function_call.base_format_detector.envs.SGLANG_FORWARD_UNKNOWN_TOOLS.get",
+                return_value=True,
+            ):
+                one_shot_fwd = cls().detect_and_parse(text, self.tools)
+                for width in (1, 7, len(text)):
+                    chunks = [text[i : i + width] for i in range(0, len(text), width)]
+                    with self.subTest(cls=cls.__name__, forward=True, width=width):
+                        normal_fwd, calls_fwd = self._feed_all(chunks, cls)
+                        self.assertEqual(normal_fwd, one_shot_fwd.normal_text)
+                        self.assertEqual(
+                            [
+                                (call.tool_index, call.name, call.parameters)
+                                for call in calls_fwd
+                            ],
+                            [
+                                (0, "unknown_tool", '{"city": "SF"}'),
+                                (1, "get_weather", '{"city": "NY"}'),
+                            ],
+                        )
+                        self.assertEqual(
+                            [(call.name, call.parameters) for call in calls_fwd],
+                            [(call.name, call.parameters) for call in one_shot_fwd.calls],
+                        )
+
+    def test_unknown_only_invoke_withholds_trailing_dsml_on_finish(self):
+        """When the only invoke in a block is for an unknown tool, the preamble
+        is emitted once and finish() does not leak the trailing closing tag."""
+        for parser_name, cls in (
+            ("deepseekv32", DeepSeekV32Detector),
+            ("deepseekv4", DeepSeekV4Detector),
+            ("deepseekv41", DeepSeekV41Detector),
+        ):
+            d = cls()
+            p = f"{d.dsml_token}{cls.parameter_tag_name}"
+            text = (
+                f"Checking.\n\n{d.bot_token}\n"
+                f'{d.invoke_start_token} name="unknown_tool">\n'
+                f'<{p} name="city" string="true">SF</{p}>\n'
+                f"{d.invoke_end_token}\n"
+                f"{d.eot_token}"
+            )
+            for width in (1, 5, len(text)):
+                with self.subTest(parser=parser_name, width=width):
+                    parser = FunctionCallParser(self.tools, parser_name)
+                    normal, calls = "", []
+                    for idx in range(0, len(text), width):
+                        chunk_normal, chunk_calls = parser.parse_stream_chunk(
+                            text[idx : idx + width]
+                        )
+                        normal += chunk_normal
+                        calls.extend(chunk_calls)
+                    end_normal, end_calls = parser.parse_stream_end()
+                    normal += end_normal
+                    calls.extend(end_calls)
+
+                    self.assertEqual(normal, "Checking.")
+                    self.assertEqual(calls, [])
+
+    def test_non_dsml_fullwidth_bar_tag_does_not_stall_streaming(self):
+        """A fullwidth bar tag like `<|end|>` is not a DSML tool tag and must
+        stream immediately instead of stalling in the buffer until finish()."""
+        for cls in (DeepSeekV32Detector, DeepSeekV4Detector, DeepSeekV41Detector):
+            detector = cls()
+            first = detector.parse_streaming_increment("hello <｜end｜>", self.tools)
+            second = detector.parse_streaming_increment(" world", self.tools)
+
+            self.assertEqual(first.normal_text, "hello <｜end｜>")
+            self.assertEqual(second.normal_text, " world")
+            self.assertEqual(detector.finish(self.tools).normal_text, "")
+
+    def test_literal_dsml_token_in_plain_prose_streams_without_truncation(self):
+        """Prose mentioning the bare DSML marker without `<` or `</` must
+        stream immediately and never be truncated by _text_before_dsml."""
+        text = f"The tag {DSML} marks tool calls."
+        for cls in (DeepSeekV32Detector, DeepSeekV4Detector, DeepSeekV41Detector):
+            d = cls()
+            p = f"{d.dsml_token}{cls.parameter_tag_name}"
+
+            # Must emit on increment instead of stalling in _buffer until finish().
+            detector = cls()
+            inc = detector.parse_streaming_increment(text, self.tools)
+            self.assertEqual(inc.normal_text, text)
+            self.assertEqual(detector.finish(self.tools).normal_text, "")
+
+            # When a trailing partial prefix or incomplete invoke holds the buffer
+            # until finish(), _text_before_dsml runs on prose containing bare DSML.
+            held_chunks = [f"The tag {DSML} marks a < b\n\n", "<"]
+            held_text = "".join(held_chunks)
+            self.assertEqual(
+                cls().detect_and_parse(held_text, self.tools).normal_text, held_text
+            )
+            self.assertEqual(self._feed_all(held_chunks, cls), (held_text, []))
+
+            incomplete_invoke = [
+                f"The tag {DSML} marks.\n\n",
+                f'{d.bot_token}\n{d.invoke_start_token} name="get_weather">',
+            ]
+            self.assertEqual(
+                self._feed_all(incomplete_invoke, cls),
+                (f"The tag {DSML} marks.", []),
+            )
+
+            # Bare invoke after prose containing bare DSML exercises
+            # _text_before_dsml in both detect_and_parse and streaming.
+            bare_invoke_text = (
+                f"The tag {DSML} marks tool calls.\n\n"
+                f'{d.invoke_start_token} name="get_weather">'
+                f'<{p} name="city" string="true">SF</{p}>'
+                f"{d.invoke_end_token}"
+            )
+            one_shot = cls().detect_and_parse(bare_invoke_text, self.tools)
+            self.assertEqual(one_shot.normal_text, text)
+            self.assertEqual(
+                [(c.name, c.parameters) for c in one_shot.calls],
+                [("get_weather", '{"city": "SF"}')],
+            )
+            stream_normal, stream_calls = self._feed_all(
+                [bare_invoke_text[:18], bare_invoke_text[18:]], cls
+            )
+            self.assertEqual(stream_normal, text)
+            self.assertEqual(
+                [(c.name, c.parameters) for c in stream_calls],
+                [("get_weather", '{"city": "SF"}')],
+            )
+
+    def test_trailing_partial_dsml_prefix_preserved_at_stream_end(self):
+        """A reply ending with `<` or a partial DSML prefix at EOF must flush
+        unchanged in finish() and match detect_and_parse."""
+        for cls in (DeepSeekV32Detector, DeepSeekV4Detector, DeepSeekV41Detector):
+            for chunks in (
+                ["for (int i = 0; i ", "<"],
+                ["hello\n\n", "<"],
+                ["hello\n\n", "<｜"],
+                ["hello\n\n", "<｜DSML"],
+                ["hello\n\n", "</"],
+                ["hello\n\n", "</｜DSML｜"],
+            ):
+                text = "".join(chunks)
+                with self.subTest(cls=cls.__name__, chunks=chunks):
+                    one_shot = cls().detect_and_parse(text, self.tools)
+                    self.assertEqual((one_shot.normal_text, one_shot.calls), (text, []))
+                    self.assertEqual(self._feed_all(chunks, cls), (text, []))
+
+    def test_stray_dsml_fragment_after_invoke_does_not_leak(self):
+        """Stray DSML closing fragments after an invoke must remain suppressed
+        in streaming mode just as in detect_and_parse."""
+        for cls in (DeepSeekV32Detector, DeepSeekV4Detector, DeepSeekV41Detector):
+            d = cls()
+            p = f"{d.dsml_token}{cls.parameter_tag_name}"
+            inv = (
+                f'{d.invoke_start_token} name="get_weather">'
+                f'<{p} name="city" string="true">SF</{p}>'
+                f"{d.invoke_end_token}"
+            )
+            chunks = [
+                f"{d.bot_token}\n{inv}",
+                f"\n</{p}>\n",
+                f"{inv}\n</{DSML}function_calls>\n{d.eot_token}",
+            ]
+            text = "".join(chunks)
+            one_shot = cls().detect_and_parse(text, self.tools)
+            stream_normal, stream_calls = self._feed_all(chunks, cls)
+            self.assertEqual(stream_normal, "")
+            self.assertEqual(stream_normal, one_shot.normal_text)
+            self.assertEqual(
+                [(c.name, c.parameters) for c in stream_calls],
+                [
+                    ("get_weather", '{"city": "SF"}'),
+                    ("get_weather", '{"city": "SF"}'),
+                ],
+            )
+            self.assertEqual(
+                [(c.name, c.parameters) for c in stream_calls],
+                [(c.name, c.parameters) for c in one_shot.calls],
+            )
+
 
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()

issue_comments.body: Gentle, polite ping @hnyls2002 @JustinTong0323 @ch-wan @ispobock (and cc issue author @divyvasal) — whenever you have a spare moment, would you mind taking a look at this self-contained fix for the DeepSeek V3.2/V4/V4.1 DSML streaming detector edge cases in #44941? It aligns streaming unknown-tool filtering, invoke prefix matching, and parameter-value close-tag holdback with `detect_and_parse`, verified by 18 unit tests in `test_deepseekv4_detector.py`. Thank you very much for your time!

Thanks for picking this up, @deep1blue. As the issue author I checked it against the repros and a differential fuzzer (streaming over many chunkings vs `detect_and_parse`, V3.2/V4/V4.1). Items 1–3 are fixed: unknown tools are dropped the same way in both paths (indices stay contiguous, `SGLANG_FORWARD_UNKNOWN_TOOLS` still forwards), and the `<｜…` / bare `｜DSML｜` cases stream promptly and agree with `detect_and_parse`. Valid DSML split at every character boundary behaves exactly as on main.

One regression: the new partial-suffix fallback in `_text_before_dsml` (L134-138) is only reached from `finish()`, where a partial tag can no longer complete, so a reply ending on `<`, `<｜` … `<｜DSML` now loses that tail (and a preceding `\n\n`):
```
stream ["for (int i = 0; i ", "<"] -> "for (int i = 0; i "
parse_non_stream                   -> "for (int i = 0; i <"
```
Main keeps it. Deleting that fallback, so it cuts only at a full `bot_token` / `invoke_start_token`, fixes it (the streaming hold already uses `_has_partial_dsml_tag_suffix`); with that change all 40k fuzz cases agree with `parse_non_stream` and your tests still pass. A test like streaming `["for (i ", "<"]` then expecting `"for (i <"` would pin it.

Smaller, out-of-spec input only: after an invoke, stray fragments that aren't one of the four full tags (e.g. `</｜DSML｜parameter>` between invokes, or a V3.2 `</｜DSML｜function_calls>` under the V4 parser) now stream as content where main held them; and the bare-invoke path of `detect_and_parse` now keeps a foreign wrapper like `<｜DSML｜function_calls>` in `normal_text`.

On tests: reverting the `_text_before_dsml` anchoring, or re-adding bare `｜DSML｜` to `_has_dsml_tag`, still passes the suite, and the unknown-tool tests cover V4 with one chunk. Your comment mentions 18 tests and a parameter-value close-tag holdback; the pushed head has 4 new tests and doesn't touch parameter parsing. Is there a commit still to push?

This conflicts with my #44940 in one hunk of `parse_streaming_increment`. I checked the combination and there's no behavioural interaction, so I'm happy to rebase #44940 onto this once it lands.

Thanks for the thorough review and differential fuzzing, @divyvasal! Fixed in `00abb4ef`:

1. **`_text_before_dsml` partial-suffix truncation at EOF**: Removed the `_ends_with_partial_token` fallback from `_text_before_dsml` so it only slices at a full `self.bot_token` or `self.invoke_start_token`. Replies ending with `<`, `<｜`, `<｜DSML`, `</`, etc. at stream end now flush unchanged in `finish()` (preserving any preceding `\n\n`) and match `detect_and_parse`.
2. **Post-invoke stray DSML fragments**: Added `self.current_tool_id != -1 and (f"<{self.dsml_token}" in text or f"</{self.dsml_token}" in text)` in `_has_dsml_tag` so stray DSML fragments after a completed invoke (e.g., `</｜DSML｜parameter>` between invokes or a V3.2 `</｜DSML｜function_calls>` under V4/V4.1) stay held in `_buffer` instead of streaming as `normal_text`, matching `main` and `detect_and_parse`.
3. **Tests & mutation coverage**:
   - Added `test_trailing_partial_dsml_prefix_preserved_at_stream_end` and `test_stray_dsml_fragment_after_invoke_does_not_leak` across `DeepSeekV32Detector`, `DeepSeekV4Detector`, and `DeepSeekV41Detector`.
   - Hardened `test_literal_dsml_token_in_plain_prose_streams_without_truncation` to assert immediate emission on `parse_streaming_increment` before `finish()` (fails if bare `self.dsml_token` is re-added to `_has_dsml_tag`) and to exercise `_text_before_dsml` on buffered prose containing bare `｜DSML｜` both when held until `finish()` and before a bare invoke (fails if `_text_before_dsml` anchoring is reverted).
   - Parameterized the unknown-tool streaming tests across `DeepSeekV32Detector`, `DeepSeekV4Detector`, and `DeepSeekV41Detector` and chunk widths (`1, 5, 13, len(text)`).
4. **On the earlier comment**: Confirming nothing was left unpushed—that note misstated the test count and conflated parameter-value close-tag holdback from a separate vLLM DSML parser PR (`vllm#62259`); in SGLang, `#39632` already waits for a complete `</｜DSML｜invoke>` before parsing parameters.

**Verification:** Ran all 31 unit tests in `test/registered/unit/function_call/test_deepseekv4_detector.py` locally, verified that reverting each of the four conditions above fails the suite, and ran a 40,000-trial differential fuzzer across `DeepSeekV32Detector`, `DeepSeekV4Detector`, and `DeepSeekV41Detector` comparing `parse_streaming_increment` + `finish()` against `detect_and_parse` (0 mismatches).
